experience.summary: Contributed to the development of autonomous navigation and control systems for agricultural robotics platforms that automate labour-intensive farming operations.
highlights: Developed autonomous navigation, localization, and path-planning capabilities for challenging agricultural environments.
Integrated embedded systems, sensors, actuators, and robotics control hardware.
Worked on perception, sensor fusion, and high-level robotic decision-making.
Developed and validated robotic behaviors through simulation and field testing.
Contributed to modular, scalable robotics software architecture supporting reliable communication across the systems.

experience.summary: Worked across flagship and next-gen platforms — docking station, advance float-kit, SD45 / SD20 / Gen 3 robots, and a clean-room-certified variant — leading mechanical design with quantified production and reliability gains.
highlights: Developed a docking station for autonomous robots in collaboration with cross-functional teams — increased uptime by 300%, reduced human intervention by 80%, and lowered costs by 25%.

Resolved design issues and upgraded key robots based on customer feedback — cut failure rates by 60%, sped up production by 30%, reduced maintenance by 20%, and boosted satisfaction and feature adoption.
Contributed to mechanical design of plastic components and electronics enclosures, integrating PCBA and sensors; supported DFM, tolerance analysis, and design traceability through PLM.
Worked on the advance float-kit and the next-generation (Gen 3) of Peppermint's flagship SD45 (Scrubber Dryer 45) and SD20 robots.
Contributed to development of a clean-room-certified robot variant.
Designed parts and assemblies across 3D-printing, sheet-metal, moulding, and FRP processes.

experience.summary: Four-year journey at COEP's robotics club — from hands-on builder to senior engineer leading mechanical design, simulation, and team management across national-level competitions.
highlights: Spearheaded the design and prototyping of robotic systems and mechanisms, overseeing mechanical design and simulation for real-world applications and national-level competitions including Robocon (2023–2025).
Contributed to technical workshops and seminars under The Robotics Society India; organised large-scale events (Robotex, Robotica) with 500+ participants.
Ensured compliance with quality standards at national competitions including the FIRST Tech Challenge.
Led and managed team activities, guiding 50+ junior members in system integration, design validation, and iterative prototyping.
Oversaw project planning, task delegation, financial management, and key decision-making — fostering technical leadership, collaboration, and sustainable knowledge transfer within the club.

experience.summary: Developed pipe-inspection robots — a versatile system for 400–900 mm pipes (scissor mechanism) and a miniature variant for 35–95 mm pipes (gear-based transformation, ATtiny85 controller).
highlights: Researched a wide range of pipe-inspection robot architectures, then designed a versatile system for navigation across pipelines of varying characteristics, diameters, and fluid dynamics.
Did conceptual design of the full-scale (scissor-mechanism) and miniature (gear-based transformation) variants and validated through analysis and simulation.
Designed the conceptual layout and feedback-controller PCB schematic in EasyEDA using an ATtiny85 microcontroller for the miniature 35–95 mm robot — focused on compactness and control precision.
Developed control system using Raspberry Pi as navigator-controller and Xbox controller as remote operator; used ArduSub for setup/control and QGroundControl for vehicle configuration.
Studied and tested multiple actuator-control strategies: sign-magnitude PWM (e.g. Cytron motor driver), locked anti-phase PWM (e.g. brushed ESCs), relay switching, and direct MOSFET drive.
Built operator interface with joystick key-mapping and QGroundControl parameter tuning; used BlueOS and Cockpit for navigation and mission management.
Performed MATLAB simulations and CFD analysis to optimise motion dynamics and thrust force requirements.
Integrated sensors for real-time imaging and fault detection within complex pipe networks.

experience.summary: Designed and developed a conceptual product through to a manufacturing-feasible prototype, coordinating vendors, simplifying processes, and running on-field testing.
highlights: Designed and developed a conceptual product, making the initial prototype manufacturing-feasible.
Got the prototype fabricated through different vendors — managed contacts and deadlines and simplified manufacturing processes.
Conducted on-field testing to assess performance under real-world conditions.
Delivered technical documentation and contributed to post-testing analysis and improvements.
